PLAN "Upper Body Reconditioning — Subacromial Impingement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY private

GOALS
GOAL primary rehabilitation
name "Restore pain-free shoulder function and scapular control"
END GOAL
GOAL secondary strength
name "Maintain and build upper-body pulling and pressing strength within safe range"
END GOAL
GOAL tertiary performance
name "Support return to recreational climbing"
END GOAL
END GOALS

PHASES
PHASE "Phase 1 — Tissue Tolerance and Motor Control" (4 weeks)
WEEK 1
DAY Monday training 50m "Scapular control and low-load pulling"
WARMUP
arm_circles 60 seconds
cat_cow 10 reps
scapular_retraction 2x15 rpe 4
prone_T 2x12 rpe 4
prone_Y 2x12 rpe 4
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
seated_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
cable_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
face_pull 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
external_rotation 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
dead_bug 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
child_pose 60 seconds
lat_stretch 45 seconds
chest_stretch 45 seconds
diaphragmatic_breathing 90 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY

WARMUP
jog_in_place 3 minutes

END WARMUP
